study type: Observational study with an in vitro experimental component
outcome: SARS-CoV-2 viral expression in term placentae
neonatal (cord blood) SARS-CoV-2 T cell responses
cohort: The study participants included pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 and their neonates, alongside placentas from non-infected women used for in vitro experiments.
finding: Vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 is rare, likely due to inefficient virus replication in placental tissues, despite maternal immune activation in response to the infection.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth/delivery for placental analysis and neonatal infection assessment.
